data.desc: Beyond Meat, Inc. (NASDAQ: BYND), otherwise known as Beyond The Plant Protein Company, is a plant protein company offering a portfolio of plant-based products made with non-GMO ingredients, no added hormones or antibiotics, and 0mg of cholesterol per serving. Founded in 2009, Beyond Meats core products are designed to have the same taste and texture as animal-based meat while being better for people and the planet. The companys brand promise, Eat What You Love, represents a strong belief that there is a better way to feed our future and that the positive choices we all make, no matter how small, can have a great impact on our personal health and the health of our planet. By shifting from animal-based protein to plant-based protein, we can positively impact four growing global issues: human health, climate change, constraints on natural resources and animal welfare.
